fact: UNESCO's project 3210652071 (USD 166,800, 66% progress, 2024-2025) on digital skills and media and information literacy for populations is on going, with an allocation to this country (Congo 10%).
The article says the Congo Digital Transformation Project, launched by the government in January 2023, provides for 3,000 people to acquire certified digital skills from basic to advanced.

fact: The European Investment Bank says the Congolese Prime Minister's representative launched the EU part of the digital transformation project on 17 June 2025, which aims to develop the digital skills of the Congolese population, especially young people and women; the five-year EU part began in November 2024.
